items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: No, not Bob. A little fat cat with the bass... You'd see them together.

ctx.x: Yes. He's the one who started drinkin' wine, and he used to go out and play.

Drunk Bob. Bob? No, not Bob. A little fat cat with the bass. It's a three-string bass that's made out of twine. And his buddy. You'd see them together. That cat played a whole lot of music, but it would be jive, you know. And he played for ofays. He'd go in White ballrooms, no nigger ballrooms. They'd go in White ballrooms. But they were two funny niggers to see. And they'd play Irish songs, and play ...(?)... -- you know, whatever the Cajuns wanted.
